browser.environment: Headless Chromium, local HTML fixtures and deterministic mocked Steam transport; not a live-network benchmark.
limitations: Hidden-state logic is simulated; browser freezing/discarding is outside this harness.
Fixtures do not establish current live-site markup, CSP, script-manager, or media-codec compatibility.
The original baseline receives a valid legacy review response to isolate pipeline work from endpoint retirement.

liveSteam.environment: Live Steam requests from Node fetch; actual Chromium DOMParser; shared provider engine without UI/network-image loading. One connection; not a representative p95 benchmark.

limitations: One live connection is not a representative latency benchmark.

diagnosis.fix: Verified same-AppID alias with returned ID/name/type validation. Not a direct lookup shortcut or generic subtitle removal.
diagnosis.skyrim: Protect Special/Anniversary edition words from commercial-tier cleanup; original, Special Edition and VR remain distinct.
diagnosis.aliasLimitation: Unrelated semantic renames still require official evidence and an additional tested alias group.

publication.method: In-app browser: filled generated code and Markdown changelog, replaced the description screenshot, posted and verified public version, rendered version-only heading and loaded image.
publication.notes:
## 4.05

- Recognize Disco Elysium as Disco Elysium – The Final Cut using its verified Steam identity.
- Improve edition matching so Skyrim Special Edition matches directly while original Skyrim, Special Edition and VR stay separate.
publication.historicalChangelogLimit: New release headings use versions only. Greasy Fork exposes no author edit control for already-posted version changelogs; historical entries were not deleted.

ciCheckoutRegression.problem: The 1337x runner assumed a sibling folder named 1337x, so GitHub checkout names caused ENOENT before loading the userscript.
ciCheckoutRegression.fix: Both runners locate their own product through build.config.json and support explicit roots for the other product.

standalone.environment: Isolated fixture checkout named standalone-checkout-arbitrary-name, with no sibling userscript artifact.
